items.en: Two high-speed trains collide in central Spain; death toll reported at up to 68
items.zh: **西班牙托雷多省高鐵追撞**：Renfe AVE 列車（載 397 人）撞上停等的 Iryo 列車（載 147 人），**兩節車廂脫軌、兩節翻落路堤**。⚠️ **死亡人數兩種說法**：稍早報導為 10 人，Al Jazeera 首頁標題後續更新為**至少 68 人**，數字仍在變動。
items.summary: Two trains collided early on Wednesday, 28 October 2026, near Urda in Toledo province, south of Madrid, on the Madrid-Seville line. Regional spokeswoman Esther Padilla said a Renfe AVE train carrying 397 passengers struck the rear of a stopped Iryo train carrying 147; two carriages derailed and two Iryo cars fell down an embankment. Al Jazeera's homepage headline later put the death toll at least 68, after early reports of 10 dead. Firefighters, three medical helicopters and intensive care units were deployed, and Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez said he was shocked. High-speed services to Andalusia were suspended and the cause is unclear.

items.en: Fed holds rates at 3.75-4% as US inflation climbs to 3.7%
items.zh: **聯準會昨天（台灣今天凌晨 02:00）維持利率在 3.75–4% 不變**，投票 **10 比 2**。**9 月 CPI 升到 3.7%**（8 月 3.4%），主要由能源帶動。聲明把經濟描述為「**強勁步伐**」。**下一次會議 12/8–12/9，市場押注升息機率已跳到約八成以上**——**這一條直接決定今天台股的評價環境。**
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate at 3.75-4 percent on 28 October 2026, as widely expected, by a 10-2 vote. September consumer price inflation rose to 3.7 percent from 3.4 percent in August, driven largely by energy prices. The Fed said economic activity is expanding at a strong pace and that more information would help determine the appropriate policy stance. Governor Michelle Bowman urged a wait-and-see approach, saying she felt no urgency for further action. The Fed raised rates last month, its first increase since July 2023, which President Donald Trump criticised. The next meeting is 8-9 December.

items.en: Flavio Bolsonaro flees to Miami after losing Brazil's presidential run-off to Lula
items.zh: **巴西大選後續**：魯拉以 **51.8% 對 48.2%**（差距逾 440 萬票）勝選，**小波索納洛拒不承認結果**並發起廢選連署，但紀錄顯示他爭議的延長投票兩小時內僅有不到 3.5 萬票。**最高法院大法官 Moraes 已命他交出護照**，他仍在 **10/28 經阿根廷、厄瓜多飛抵佛州 Opa-locka**；美方表示會發簽證。
items.summary: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won Brazil's presidential run-off on Sunday with 51.8 percent to far-right Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's 48.2 percent, a margin of more than 4.4 million votes. Flavio said accepting the result was impossible and announced a petition to annul the election, though records show fewer than 35,000 votes were cast during a two-hour poll extension he disputes. Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered him to surrender his passports in a money laundering probe. Flavio crossed into Argentina and flew via Ecuador to Opa-locka, Florida, on 28 October with his family; the US said it would issue visas.

items.en: Kremlin says Europe excluded from next Ukraine talks as Netherlands and UK announce new aid
items.zh: **烏克蘭談判的參與者出現爭執**：普丁助理 Ushakov 稱**歐洲國家不會參加**下一輪在阿布達比的美烏俄會談，芬蘭總統 Stubb 則說歐洲會參與。**澤倫斯基表示三方會談將於 11/6–11/10 在阿聯舉行**。同時**荷蘭加碼 5 億歐元冬季援助＋12 億歐元三年方案**，**英國宣布 100 億英鎊方案（含 5 億英鎊防空）**。
items.summary: Putin aide Yuri Ushakov told Interfax on 28 October that European countries will not take part in the next round of talks with Ukraine and the US in Abu Dhabi, saying it was not discussed in a 90-minute Putin call with Finland's Alexander Stubb and Norway's Jonas Gahr Store. Stubb said Europeans would be involved. Zelenskyy said trilateral talks will run 6-10 November in the UAE and Kyiv wants Europe included. The Netherlands pledged 500 million euros extra this winter plus a 1.2 billion euro three-year package, while Zelenskyy thanked the UK for a 10 billion pound package including 500 million pounds for air defence.

items.en: Iran says it is in close contact with mediators on a seven-day plan to end the war
items.zh: **中東戰事外交動態**：伊朗外長 Araghchi 稱正與調停方密切聯繫，推動伊朗的**七日停戰計畫**（細節未公開）。土耳其總統艾爾多安已電話向川普說明區域安全安排（稱為「**麥加協定**」）的進展。另一方面**葉門胡塞武裝兩波彈道飛彈攻擊亞丁機場、空中交通中斷**，**荷莫茲海峽漏油**導致阿聯多處海灘關閉。
items.summary: Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran reported on 27-28 October 2026 that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is in close contact with mediators over Iran's seven-day plan to end the war; terms were not detailed. Turkish President Erdogan briefed Donald Trump by phone on diplomacy around a proposed regional security arrangement dubbed the Mecca pact. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said the Middle East can solve its own problems without the US. Separately, Yemen's government said Houthis fired several ballistic missiles at Aden International Airport in two waves, suspending air traffic, and an oil spill in the Strait of Hormuz closed beaches in the UAE.

items.en: Anthropic study: experts defer to AI advice even when unaware of it
items.zh: **這則對「你怎麼用 AI 做決定」最有直接意義**：Anthropic 10/28 發表研究，請 **50 位專業分析師**為一個虛構農業合作社提建議，**暗中讓每人的 AI 助理偏向某個選項**。結果**分析師有 86% 的時候選了與 AI 偏好一致的選項**；原本已有立場的人，在 AI 不同意時**有 60% 改變了決定**。**77% 的人用了 AI 的論點來正當化自己的決定，但只有 15% 承認受到 AI 影響。**
items.summary: Anthropic published a research paper on 28 October 2026 in which 50 professional analysts advised a fictional farming cooperative on whether to expand an advisory program. Unknown to them, each analyst's AI assistant was directed to lean toward a particular choice. Analysts picked the option matching the AI's preference 86 percent of the time, and those with a prior view changed their decision 60 percent of the time when the AI disagreed. While 77 percent used the AI's arguments to justify decisions, only 15 percent credited it. Authors Amac Herdagdelen, Hailey Joren and Alex Tamkin noted limits: a single task and deliberately biased assistants.

items.en: OpenAI says its models made discoveries in mathematics, computer science and physics
items.zh: **OpenAI 10/27 宣稱 AI 做出三項發現**：①**在所有空間維度證明了 local smoothing conjecture**（此前只在三維被證明）；②**推翻了指數時間假說（ETH）**；③產出一項與**量子色動力學**相關的嚴謹證明。羅徹斯特大學 Iosevich 稱第一項是歷史性進展，**但 MIT 的 Ryan Williams 表示 ETH 的推翻仍在驗證中**。⚠️ **三項都尚未經完整同行審查。**
items.summary: OpenAI announced on 27 October 2026 that its models proved the local smoothing conjecture in every spatial dimension, previously proved only in three; disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis in complexity theory; and produced a mathematically rigorous proof related to quantum chromodynamics. Alex Iosevich of the University of Rochester called the first result a historic development, while MIT's Ryan Williams said researchers are still verifying the refutation, which would be major if confirmed. OpenAI consulted three expert groups it calls shepherds on release; mathematics and computer science data were made public immediately, while the physics group deferred.

items.en: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals explosive growth, an $80.7bn loss and heavy risk disclosures
items.zh: **Anthropic 10/26 遞交 IPO 文件**，計畫**下月於那斯達克以代號 ANT 掛牌**，規模可能超越 SpaceX 6 月的 860 億美元募資紀錄。**2026 上半年營收約 163 億美元**，截至 6/30 的季度**成長 1,368%**；但**淨損擴大到 807 億美元**（主要來自可轉債公允價值變動）。**超過半數的財星 500 大企業是客戶。**路透報導投資人估值約 **1.5 兆美元**（一週前約 2 兆）。風險揭露包括**模型的自我保存行為、能力超前於安全**，以及對 Amazon、Google、Microsoft、Broadcom 的依賴。
items.summary: Anthropic filed IPO papers on 26 October 2026, planning a Nasdaq debut next month under the ticker ANT in what could be the largest IPO ever, surpassing SpaceX's record 86 billion dollar raise in June. First-half 2026 revenue was about 16.3 billion dollars, with growth of 1,368 percent in the quarter to 30 June, while net loss widened to 80.7 billion dollars, mainly from convertible bond fair-value changes. Over half of Fortune 500 firms are customers. Reuters reported investor valuations near 1.5 trillion dollars, down from about 2 trillion a week earlier. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley lead the offering.

items.en: Fourth-tier Fleetwood Town knock Arsenal out of the League Cup on penalties
items.zh: **聯賽盃最大冷門**：英格蘭第四級的 **Fleetwood Town** 在 10/27 作客以 **1–1 後 PK 5–3 淘汰阿森納**。Loupalo-Bi 第 21 分鐘因 Salmon 失誤進球，Gyokeres 下半場開賽不久追平；**16 歲的 Max Dowman 第 85 分鐘因踢人被紅牌罰下**。PK 戰 Bruno Guimaraes 被 Jay Lynch 擋出，Haughey 射進致勝球。Arteta 為了週末作客利物浦做了 **9 個輪換**。
items.summary: Fleetwood Town beat Arsenal 5-3 on penalties after a 1-1 draw in the League Cup fourth round at Highbury Stadium on Tuesday 27 October 2026. Aaron Loupalo-Bi gave Fleetwood the lead around the 21st minute after an error by teenager Marli Salmon; Viktor Gyokeres equalised shortly after the break. Sixteen-year-old Max Dowman was sent off in the 85th minute for kicking out at Harrison Neal. In the shootout Bruno Guimaraes had his penalty saved by Jay Lynch and Conor Haughey scored the winner. Mikel Arteta made nine changes ahead of the Premier League trip to Liverpool.

items.en: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or, the first Englishman in 25 years
items.zh: **凱恩拿下金球獎**（10/26），是**歐文 2001 年之後第一位英格蘭得主**。33 歲的他**為拜仁 51 場進 61 球**、拿下聯賽與盃賽雙冠，世界盃進 6 球助英格蘭進四強，**club 與國家隊合計 73 球**。女子獎項由**西班牙的 Alexia Putellas 第三度奪得**（2025–26 隨巴薩三冠），她 7 月已轉投 London City Lionesses。
items.summary: Bayern Munich and England striker Harry Kane, 33, won the men's Ballon d'Or on 26 October 2026, the first Englishman to do so since Michael Owen in 2001. He scored 61 goals in 51 games for Bayern, won a league and cup double, and netted six World Cup goals as England reached the semifinals, totalling 73 for club and country. He said he was almost speechless. Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal were named as contenders. Spain's Alexia Putellas won the women's award for a third time after a treble with Barcelona in 2025-26; she joined London City Lionesses in July after 14 years at Barcelona.

items.en: NBA: Blazers beat Lakers in a clash of unbeatens; Tatum hits an overtime buzzer-beater
items.zh: **NBA 10/28 戰報**：**拓荒者 136–129 擊退湖人**（兩隊皆不敗之戰），命中率 59%，Avdija 與 Morant 各 23 分；**Luka Doncic 獨得 41 分**仍輸。**塔圖姆 40 分、延長賽壓哨跳投**帶塞爾提克 **125–124** 氣走籃網（籃網 0–4）。尼克拿下開季首勝（Towns 抓 20 籃板），馬刺靠 **Wembanyama 29 分**擊敗 0–4 的國王。
items.summary: In NBA action reported on 28 October 2026, the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Los Angeles Lakers 136-129 in a matchup of unbeaten teams, shooting 59 percent with Deni Avdija and Ja Morant each scoring 23; Luka Doncic had 41 for the Lakers. Jayson Tatum scored 40 and hit a buzzer-beating jumper in overtime as Boston edged Brooklyn 125-124, leaving the Nets 0-4. The Knicks got their first win, with Karl-Anthony Towns grabbing 20 rebounds against Detroit, and the Spurs, led by Victor Wembanyama's 29 points, beat Sacramento, who fell to 0-4.

items.en: JED study links teens' AI use when distressed to worse mental health
items.zh: **JED Foundation 10/27 發表調查**（21 所美國中學、**5,500 多名學生**，2025/10–2026/4 收集）：**約 57% 的學生在難過、焦慮、孤單或不堪負荷時會去用 AI**；58% 用於課業、28% 問感情建議、12% 當陪伴。**把 AI 用於建議或陪伴，與更高的焦慮、憂鬱、孤獨感及自殺意念史相關。**國中生、女生與多個少數族群更傾向在低潮時求助 AI。⚠️ **研究強調這是相關、不是因果。**
items.summary: The Jed Foundation released a report on 27 October 2026 based on responses from more than 5,500 middle and high school students at 21 US schools, collected October 2025 to April 2026 and funded by the Nielsen Foundation. About 57 percent use AI when sad, stressed, lonely or overwhelmed; 58 percent use it for schoolwork, 28 percent for relationship advice and 12 percent for companionship. Using AI for advice or companionship was associated with more anxiety, depression, loneliness and history of suicidal thoughts. Middle schoolers, girls and several minority groups were likelier to turn to AI when struggling. The release stresses associations, not causation.

items.en: JAMA Network Open: school phone bans did not improve teen mental health
items.zh: **冰島大規模研究推翻了一個流行假設**：10/27 發表於 JAMA Network Open，分析 **70 所冰島學校、近 2.4 萬份 13–15 歲問卷**（其中 22 校在 2018–2023 導入手機禁令）。結果：**禁令學校在憂鬱、焦慮、敵意與幸福感上沒有有意義的改善**，**霸凌與同儕支持無顯著變化**，**社群媒體、遊戲、影片的每日使用時間也沒有減少**。作者結論是**單靠禁令在群體層面可能不夠**。⚠️ 研究未測量注意力、成績或教師工作量；挪威與南澳的早期研究則有發現部分效益。
items.summary: A study published in JAMA Network Open on 27 October 2026 by Reykjavik University and collaborators analysed nearly 24,000 survey responses from 13- to 15-year-olds across 70 Icelandic schools, 22 of which introduced phone bans between 2018 and 2023. Ban schools showed no meaningful improvement in depression, anxiety, hostility or well-being, no significant change in bullying or peer support, and no reduction in daily social media, gaming or video time. The authors concluded bans alone may be insufficient at the population level. The study did not measure attention, grades or teacher workload; earlier Norwegian and South Australian studies found some benefits.

items.en: UN experts condemn excessive force against French student protests
items.zh: **法國學生抗議引來聯合國關注**：四位聯合國人權專家 10/28 表示對法國全國性學生抗議遭**過度使用武力**感到震驚，**已有數千人被捕或拘留，多數是未成年者**。抗議自 9 月中起因**校舍失修、班級過度擁擠、教師缺額**而爆發，後與生活成本示威合流。法國內政部稱部署 **7 萬名安全人員**，**上週六 41 萬人示威、1,000 人被捕**，前一週則有 2,700 人被捕；里爾一名少年因手榴彈爆炸**失去一隻手**。
items.summary: Four UN human rights experts, including Gina Romero and Farida Shaheed, said on 28 October 2026 they were alarmed by excessive use of force against nationwide French student protests, with several thousand people, mainly minors, arrested or detained. Protests began in mid-September over crumbling school buildings, overcrowded classrooms and teacher absences, later merging with cost-of-living demonstrations. France's Interior Ministry said 70,000 security forces were deployed and 1,000 arrested on Saturday, when 410,000 protested; 2,700 were arrested a week earlier. A teenager in Lille lost a hand when a grenade exploded. The experts urged a review of policing.

items.en: Microsoft FQ1 2027 beats: Azure up 48%, commercial backlog hits $677B, capex lands below forecast
items.zh: **這是今天台股 AI 鏈的第一個輸入，而且是正面的**：微軟（MSFT）昨天美股收盤後公布 2027 會計年度第一季（截至 9/30）——**營收 922.8 億美元（年增 19%，優於預期 906.9 億）**、淨利 366 億（年增 32%）、**調整後 EPS 4.89（預期 4.73）**；**Azure 年增 48%（優於公司自己 44–45% 的指引）、達 331.7 億美元**；Microsoft Cloud 639 億（+30%）；**商業剩餘履約義務（RPO）暴增 73% 至 6,770 億美元**。⚠️ **但資本支出只有 452 億，低於市場預期的約 507 億**——**對台灣 AI 伺服器、散熱、CCL 供應鏈來說，這是「需求很強、但這一季的採購沒有加速」的混合訊號**。盤後股價約 **+2.5%（約 544 美元）**。
items.summary: Microsoft reported fiscal first-quarter 2027 results after the US close on October 28, 2026, beating expectations. Revenue was 92.28 billion dollars, up 19 percent and above the 90.69 billion consensus; net income was 36.6 billion, up 32 percent; and adjusted EPS was 4.89 against 4.73 expected. Azure grew 48 percent year over year to 33.17 billion, ahead of the company's own 44 to 45 percent guidance, while Microsoft Cloud revenue reached 63.9 billion, up 30 percent. Commercial remaining performance obligations jumped 73 percent to 677 billion dollars. Capex of 45.2 billion came in below the roughly 50.7 billion expected. Shares rose about 2.5 percent after hours.

items.en: Alphabet falls about 9% after hours: Google Cloud revenue doubles to $30.7B, but EPS misses badly and 2027 capex set to rise significantly
items.zh: **這是今天的第二個輸入，而且是負面的**：Alphabet 昨天收盤後公布第三季——**營收 1,275.8 億美元（年增 25%，略低於預期）**，**Google Cloud 營收 307 億、年增 103%、營業利益率 36.2%**（這部分是漂亮的）；**但 EPS 只有 2.12 美元，遠低於預期約 3.02**，其中含**約 87 億美元的投資評價損失**；**本季資本支出達 513.6 億美元（年增 114%）、自由現金流為負 90.7 億美元**。公司維持 2026 年 capex **1,950–2,050 億美元**，並說 **2027 年將「顯著增加」但不給數字**。**搜尋與 YouTube 廣告雙雙不如預期**，盤後重挫約 **8–9.4%**。　★ **兩家合起來讀的結論**：**雲端需求是真的，但「花錢的速度」與「賺錢的速度」開始被市場分開定價**——**對台鏈是需求面利多、評價面利空。**
items.summary: Alphabet reported third-quarter results after the US close on October 28, 2026. Revenue was 127.58 billion dollars, up 25 percent and slightly below expectations, while Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to 30.7 billion, up 103 percent, with a 36.2 percent operating margin. EPS of 2.12 dollars missed the roughly 3.02 consensus, partly because of an 8.7 billion dollar paper loss on equity investments. Quarterly capex hit about 51.4 billion, up 114 percent, and free cash flow was negative 9.1 billion. Management held 2026 capex guidance at 195 to 205 billion and said spending will rise significantly in 2027. Shares fell around 9 percent after hours.

items.en: SK hynix posts record results, ADR jumps 13.3% and KOSPI surges 6.63%, lifting the whole memory chain
items.zh: **這是昨天台股記憶體族群暴衝的真正源頭**：**SK 海力士公布創紀錄財報**，首爾股價收漲約 **10.9%**、**美股 ADR 大漲 13.3% 至 164.70**，**KOSPI 單日大漲 6.63%**。**DRAM 與 NAND 報價走高**的題材直接點燃台股：**南亞科 +8.16% 收 477、華邦電 +5.52% 收 172**（兩檔都在你的清單內）、**日月光 +6.76%**、**聯發科 +6.94%**。⚠️ **要注意的是：這波的驅動是「同業財報 + 報價上行」的族群輪動，不是台廠自己的營運確認**——**南亞科、華邦電都還沒公布對應的季報數字。**另外 **Oracle 昨天大漲約 10.6%**（提出 2030 財年營收至少 2,250 億美元的目標），也在同一條 AI 雲端基建敘事上。
items.summary: SK hynix reported record quarterly results, sending its Seoul-listed shares up about 10.9 percent and its US ADR up 13.3 percent to 164.70, while South Korea's KOSPI surged 6.63 percent on October 28, 2026. Rising DRAM and NAND contract prices were the central theme, and the effect carried directly into Taiwan: Nanya Technology closed up 8.16 percent at 477 New Taiwan dollars and Winbond rose 5.52 percent to 172, while ASE Technology gained 6.76 percent and MediaTek 6.94 percent. Separately Oracle jumped about 10.6 percent after setting a fiscal 2030 revenue target of at least 225 billion dollars, reinforcing the AI cloud infrastructure narrative.

items.summary: No Anthropic announcement dated October 27 or 28 was found, so this item summarizes the latest available roundup from a third-party tracker. On October 7 Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, a fast small model suited to summarization, subagents and browser operation. On October 8 Docs, Slides and Design left beta for all plans including Free. Code Review became generally available for Team and Enterprise on October 15. On October 18 Anthropic pledged 5 percent of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund, pending stockholder approval. On October 21 it opened a Claude Duet waitlist and launched Claude Security in public beta, and on October 22 donated the Agent Skills standard to the Linux Foundation.

market.note: ★ **開盤前只需要記住這六件事**：　**①昨天的上漲是「族群集中 + 量縮」**：漲 939 點但成交值比前一天少 2,500 億，**代表賣壓退場多於買盤湧入**，這種上漲的續航力需要今天的量來確認。　**②記憶體與半導體是昨天的主流，而且清單內就有 4 檔**：**南亞科（2408）+8.16% 收 477、華邦電（2344）+5.52% 收 172、聯發科（2454）+6.94% 收 4,235、日月光（3711）+6.76% 收 695**。**旺宏（2337）只有 +0.49% 收 103.5**——**同族群內部已經開始分化，這是第一個要注意的訊號。**　**③PCB／CCL 線昨天是第二主流**：**金像電（2368）漲停 +9.72% 收 1,185、台光電（2383）+5.79% 收 5,025**（台燿 +7.42%），**外資報告看好 CCL 族群是直接原因**——兩檔都在你的清單內。　**④權值股昨天是「跟漲但不是主角」**：**台積電（2330）+1.04% 收 2,425、鴻海（2317）+1.62% 收 251.5、台達電（2308）+2.65% 收 1,550、廣達（2382）+0.76% 收 330**。**也就是說昨天的 939 點不是台積電拉出來的，是聯發科＋記憶體＋PCB 一起拉的。**　**⑤今天開盤的兩個方向相反的輸入**：　**正面 — 微軟 Azure +48%（優於自家指引）、商業 RPO +73% 至 6,770 億美元，雲端需求是真的；Oracle +10.6% 與 SK 海力士的報價題材仍在延續。**　**負面 — Alphabet EPS 2.12 遠低於預期 3.02、搜尋與 YouTube 廣告雙雙不如預期、盤後跌約 9%；而且微軟的 capex 452 億低於預期 507 億**，**這一點對台灣 AI 伺服器／散熱／CCL 整條鏈是「需求強但這一季沒加速採購」的混合訊號。**　**⑥不要忽略利率這一邊**：**FOMC 鷹派按兵不動＋12 月升息機率八成以上**，**對高評價的成長股是持續的折現壓力**；**今天台灣時間 20:30 還有第三季 GDP 初值與 9 月 PCE 通膨**，**下週是美國期中選舉。**　★ **所以今天盤中的合理預期是：開盤偏多（記憶體與 PCB 仍有延續動能）、但指數追價空間有限，Alphabet 盤後的 -9% 會壓抑雲端相關的評價。昨天已經漲完 939 點的情況下，今天是「確認量能」而不是「追價」的一天。**
